{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that deduplication reduced the row count by 48
print(f'After deduplication, shape: {df_dedup.shape}')
print(f'Expected reduction: 848 - 48 = {848 - 48}')

# Now filter to treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']
print(f'Treatment arm size after deduplication: {len(df_treatment)}')"}
